page.description: ReactOS editions and architectures: compare, download official images, or prepare a USB with ROMinit CLI.
page.intro: An open-source operating system that reimplements the Windows NT architecture and runs Windows applications and drivers, still labelled alpha by its own project.
pros: Runs Windows binaries and drivers without Windows.
Free and open source, with its own kernel and Win32 subsystem.
Installable from CD or a live USB route.
cons: Alpha software: the project warns of corrupted file systems and overwritten partitions.
The release download is a ZIP archive containing ReactOS.iso.
The project publishes no digest or signature for the release artifacts.
page.previewNote: No screenshot with a reusable licence was confirmed for ReactOS; the page shows the logo only. No image was written to a USB stick and nothing was booted.
page.status: The release ships as a ZIP containing ReactOS.iso: unzip, then write the ISO to a stick or burn it to a CD. Installing overwrites the target disk; the project warns that alpha builds can corrupt file systems.
